task_completion.description: The Weasis DICOM viewer is launched and displaying the CT image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing the Weasis application window active with a medical image (CT/Angiography) loaded in the main viewport.

task_completion.description: The agent selects the three-point angle measurement tool from the toolbar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The angle measurement icon in the Weasis toolbar is highlighted or active, or the cursor is shown interacting with the tool menu.

task_completion.description: The agent uses the tool to place three points on the image to define an angle.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image viewport shows a three-point angle annotation (two lines meeting at a vertex) with a numerical degree value displayed next to it.

task_completion.description: The agent saves a screenshot of the viewer showing the measurement to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or terminal command showing the creation of /home/ga/DICOM/exports/angle_measurement.png, or the 'Save' dialog in Weasis pointing to that path.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a text report with the specific required format and values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing the file /home/ga/DICOM/exports/angle_report.txt containing 'Angle: [value]', 'Unit: degrees', and 'Location: CT slice structure alignment'.

integrity.description: The measurement was performed using the Weasis GUI tools, not simulated via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Weasis measurement tools and the annotation appearing dynamically on the DICOM image.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a fake report without opening the DICOM file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Weasis viewer must be visible with the specific image (0002.DCM) loaded before the report is generated.

integrity.description: The agent did not copy-paste the report content from a hidden source without performing the measurement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The angle value in the text report should match the numerical value visible in the Weasis measurement annotation on the screen.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the Weasis three-point angle tool. The expected angle value should be between 1.0 and 179.0 degrees. The screenshot must be saved to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/angle_measurement.png and be at least 5000 bytes. The report must be at /home/ga/DICOM/exports/angle_report.txt with exactly three lines: 'Angle: <value>', 'Unit: degrees', and 'Location: CT slice structure alignment'.
